adaptive_rule: Fixed pre-test. At CaDiCaL 256-conflict checkpoint, observe net retained redundant clauses and active variables. Extend phase hints by next 768 conflicts if net retained >= max(48,ceil(initial_active/4)) and active_256>0; else unphase and continue unlimited. Both cases resume same CaDiCaL instance; adaptive_plain matches identical decision without hints.
clause_quality_rule: Frozen before holdout: attach official CaDiCaL Learner to observe only offered learned clause sizes; after 256-conflict incomplete solve extend initial phase hints for 768 additional conflicts iff >=32 observed clauses, >=10 with length<=5, >=20% with length<=5; otherwise unphase immediately. Never modify original CaDiCaL; no clause is imported. quality_plain matched control applies same decision without hints. No runtime-based dataset selection.
fastpath_rule: Fast Path uses only integer n and clause count: n>=180, m>=800, 3.9<=m/n<=4.4. No runtime, family, file name or SAT label. When eligible, matched no-hint and guided controls both collect sign/ternary features; other branches use plain CaDiCaL.
